name: fluxmail
description: Read, search, draft, send, and organize email in your connected mailboxes.
long_description: Fluxmail is self-hosted email infrastructure for Gmail, Outlook, and IMAP/SMTP. This bundle runs on Apple Silicon Macs with Node.js 22. Set up Fluxmail and connect a mailbox first, then install the bundle to use that local account from your MCP client. See the quickstart at https://fluxmail.ai/docs/quickstart.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List connected mailboxes and their status.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders for a connected mailbox.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List Gmail labels or Outlook categories.

tools.name: list_emails
tools.description: Browse messages with folder and metadata filters.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search one mailbox using a portable query.

tools.name: search_emails_batch
tools.description: Search several mailboxes with one query.

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Read a message and its attachment metadata.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a new email or reply draft.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Replace the content of a draft.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send, reply to, or schedule an email.

tools.name: forward_email
tools.description: Forward an email to new recipients.

tools.name: list_scheduled_emails

tools.name: modify_emails
